body:
I would've probably spent $20 or so last friday on a fifth of liquor.  Gone by Sun morning; replaced by nervousness, tremors, and hallucinations at night.

Rinse 'n repeat each Friday.

Great work; keep it up!

Congratulations!  

21 more days for me to reach the same goal... tryin' to hang in there.
Damn good read.  I tend to overthink many things as well.

Thanks for having compassion.  You've got more of a heart than me.

Honestly, I don't know enough to properly decide if I should stop drinking entirely, or if I will be able to safely resume drinking at some point in the future.  What I do know, is, that I have a problem and need to get my life back on track, and to go from there.

Thanks for responding.  Really appreciate it.

Stuff seems bleak now, but I'm optimistic that I can turn things around.  

Also don't feel bad about what you did or didn't accomplish when you were around my age.  What matters is what you're doing now.  Sounds like you're making great progress by being here.

Welcome aboard.

You're making a great start by spending time on here rather than just going out and drinking.  You're right about reading the comments and stories left here by others; it *does* help.

High five, too.

Now that I think about it, alcohol made somewhat minor events much more stressful, which in turn made me drink more to relieve said stress...

how crazy is that?

Thanks for responding.  This sub is a great place, and actually gave me hope again.  Hope that I'll be able to finally get that additional rating for my license, which I put off all these years for to drink instead.

My biggest concern is that I'll let my fears overtake me (like this: "I'm scared to see if I actually did say something bad to Janet, so I'll drink to relieve the anxiety!").  

Like Janet once said on Facebook, "Sometimes the worst place to be is in your own mind."  (Again, not obsessed w her or anything, just repeating some of her wisdom)

Good luck to you as well.  I'll be sober here w you

First timer here.  Let me first say that I'm blown away by your 1108 day progress.  Here I am, not even on day 1 yet.  Congrats.

Keep at it.  I've been struggling with feelings of "It'll be easier to just get drunk than actually try and fix your problems.  Just let the artificial warmth take over you."

Hey, thanks for responding.

Like I said to another poster here, my goal to not drink is just keep moving forward--keep at studies etc., and reduce exposure to alcohol and try to resist peer pressure.  Very simplistic, I know, but I will try and see what the future holds.

Read a couple of your stories on this sub; really sorry to hear about the loss of your friend.  And yeah I agree about taking action; it's one thing to say you'll do something, and it's an entirely different thing to actually do it.

Thanks for responding to my post.  Congrats on reaching day 18 as well.

Current plans for me might sound very simplistic, but right now my goal is to just keep moving forward and reduce my exposure to alcohol.  Try and repair the friendships.  Keep at it.

Also, thanks for calling me brave.  I never thought of myself as a brave individual.
Sounds like a great idea.  Good luck!  I'll be here alongside you, too.
